bible_refs: §3 expansion: 6–8 buyers at 88–93¢, proceeds ≈ $6.1M on $6.8M face
rationale: Two families. (1) CSC-PLACEMENT-TEMPLATE: Alder Program Administration's pre-broker placement template (DOCX), v1 5/20/22 (brackets), v2 7/18/22 (price range, Oregon law, eligibility rep in reliance on Administrator screening + 5/4/22 checklist, replacement-or-refund remedy), v3 8/12/22 (remedy made exclusive/capped/4-yr survival; Offering Jurisdictions placeholders). No broker named in any version (matches 698/616 and every carrier body). (2) CSC-CPA-BELLHAVEN: Bellhaven-prepared Credit Purchase Agreement (PDF). Parties: Seller = Cascade Timber Holdings (credit holder; CTH recognizes gross face per §1) acting through Alder Point Partners as Administrator (Sacramento, per 009); Bellhaven Advisory (Denver, per 009) joins only as Placement Agent for §§8–9 and recites the 9/2/22 non-exclusive Broker Placement Agreement, consistent with 009 (fees payable by Administrator under that agreement; no fee % stated). Eligibility rep (§5(c)) is made 'in reliance on' Administrator screening and Program Documentation incl. the 5/4/22 checklist, warranting 'all western states... including Oregon and Washington' — a representation only; truth is for the Q6 join. §8 places credits to the purchaser 'at its principal office in Oregon/Washington through Placement Agent' and says nothing about Bellhaven's registration/licensing (Q2 left open; placement dates 11/9, 11/21, 12/6/22 feed the matrix without deciding it). §4 certificate delivery within 10 Business Days, refund for undelivered face after 30. §7 Refund Request within 90 days (Blue River negotiated 120) → replacement or refund of Unit Price × disallowed face, exclusive, capped at price paid, 4-yr survival — frames the later refund demands without saying any was triggered. Figures (all in figures_ok): CPP $1,250,000 face @ $0.90 = $1,125,000 (draft $0.89 = $1,112,500); North Fork $900,000 @ $0.92 = $828,000 (draft $1,000,000 = $920,000); Blue River $1,100,000 @ $0.89 = $979,000. Executed face total $3.25M of the $6.8M recognized 2022 face (47.8%), leaving $3.55M for Willamette Family Holdings and the 2–4 smaller lots (and any non-Bellhaven 2022 placements) — i.e. ~$0.9–1.2M per remaining named buyer and smaller lots below that, consistent with 6–8 buyers. Prices 0.89–0.92 sit inside 88–93¢; blended cash on these three = $2,932,000 / $3.25M = 90.2¢, consistent with ≈$6.1M proceeds on $6.8M. No certificate numbers, batch numbers or parcel IDs are assigned to any buyer (subjects' 'batch N' are internally inconsistent; parcel mapping would be a decider). Carriers: template versions on pre-9/26/22 emails and on 631 (body fits only the template); buyer drafts on the pre-execution 2022 buyer↔Bellhaven/Alder emails; executed copies on 2023 buyer↔Alder/Bellhaven emails. Left untouched as nonsense carriers: EMAIL-594 (CPP→Blue River cc North Fork, cross-buyer), EMAIL-685 (Willamette→North Fork), EMAIL-647 (Willamette→Cascade IR), EMAIL-663 (North Fork→Cascade IR) — no version fits a buyer circulating its agreement to a competitor or to CTH investor relations, and the pre-broker template was superseded by then.
